news.title: Senate Panel Advances Jay Clayton as Next Spy Chief on Party-Line Vote
news.summary: Assuming he is confirmed by the full Senate as expected, Mr. Clayton will take command of the Office of National Intelligence from Bill Pulte, a housing official with little national security experience.
